edge.title: Double Muon wd to 0.025 (lr 0.025 kept), 3375 steps; explicit init
edge.summary: Keeps #3's Muon lr=0.025 but doubles weight decay to 0.025 (lr·wd 6.25e-4 per step at peak) and shortens the run to 3375 steps, now backed by n=20 runs. It also adopts the refactored baseline script: parameters are explicitly re-initialized inside a multi-trial loop, with Gaussian N(0, 0.33/fan_in) hidden weights instead of PyTorch's uniform default and all biases zeroed (q/k/v/fc biases were uniform), while proj weights stay zero.

changes.label: Muon wd 0.0125 → 0.025
changes.detail: optimizer2 = Muon(lr=0.025, weight_decay=0.025): same lr as #3, twice the decoupled decay p *= 1 − lr·wd.

changes.label: train_steps 3500 → 3375
changes.detail: Claimed step equals the scheduled end (no early stop).

changes.label: Explicit init, all biases zero
changes.detail: Init loop: weights with 'proj' → zero; embed → normal_() i.e. N(0,1); other weights (q, k, v, mlp.fc) → normal_(std=0.33**0.5 / fan_in**0.5) ≈ 0.0207, a Gaussian with ~torch-default std; every bias → 0 (q/k/v/fc biases were U(±1/sqrt(768))); gains → 1; unknown params raise.

changes.label: Multi-trial harness; RMSNorm call
changes.detail: num_trials = int(sys.argv[-1]) wraps init, optimizers, train_loader and training in a loop. RMSNorm becomes F.rms_norm(x, weight=gains.type_as(x)) on the bf16 activations instead of an explicit fp32 upcast (numerics-only). QK norm inlined; logs GPU name, world size and per-interval step_avg.

hparams_changed.label: q/k/v/fc init
hparams_changed.from: torch default nn.Linear U(±1/sqrt(fan_in)), std ≈ 0.0208 (q, k, v, mlp.fc)
hparams_changed.to: normal, std 0.33**0.5 / fan_in**0.5 ≈ 0.0207 (q, k, v, mlp.fc)

hparams_changed.label: bias init
hparams_changed.from: torch default U(±1/sqrt(fan_in)) for q/k/v/fc; proj biases zero

edge.parent_check: Consistent with #3: lr=0.025 is carried over and only wd/steps change. Git history: the baseline file was first refactored with #3's hparams (8dcef4a: multi-trial loop, explicit init, F.rms_norm), then set to wd=0.025 and 3375 steps (59a11d9, identical to this script). It is textually nearest to #1 only because #3's copy uses muon_lr/muon_weight_decay variables.
edge.noise: Re-indentation of the Hyperparams/Training sections under the trial loop, per-interval step_avg and device logging, F.rms_norm inlining of the QK norm.

techniques.note: lr 0.025, wd 0.025, mu 0.95 Nesterov, NS 12 iters (2,-1.5,0.5)
proj weights zero (incl. LM head); all biases now zero too

hparams.init.hidden_std: normal, std 0.33**0.5 / fan_in**0.5 ≈ 0.0207 (q, k, v, mlp.fc)
hparams.init.proj: zero (attn.proj, mlp.proj and LM head weights)

caveats: n=20 (mean 3.2788 at 3375). The wd change is confounded with the init change (Gaussian hidden weights, zero q/k/v/fc biases) and the RMSNorm numerics change; the record has no ablation separating them.
